The Kirk Key Interlock for incoming feeder cubicles is a safety feature typically included in metal-clad switchgear. The CROWN-ARMV product meets this requirement.
The detailed specifications for the copper main bus, including ratings, materials, and construction, are consistent with the capabilities of the CROWN-ARMV metal-clad switchgear.
The requirement for four-hole NEMA pads for high-voltage power cables aligns with the accessories provided in the CROWN-ACC product catalog.
The copper ground bus and its specifications are integral to the design of the CROWN-ARMV metal-clad switchgear.
The phase sequence identification requirement is a standard feature of the CROWN-ARMV metal-clad switchgear.
The BIL rating of 95kV is a design specification that the CROWN-ARMV metal-clad switchgear can meet.
The breaker specifications, including horizontal draw-out vacuum type and voltage ratings, are consistent with the CROWN-ARMV metal-clad switchgear.
